department: Department of Statistical Sciences, Statistical Sciences

deadline.value: The 2026/27 (42nd cycle) call closed May 20, 2026. The Fall 2027 (43rd cycle) call is not yet published.

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics is welcome 'if available'; no subject test is required.
gre_subject.quote: At most 2 reference letters. GRE, GRE ... Mathematics, if available

supervisor.value: Applicants need not contact a supervisor first; the Academic Board assigns one within four months of course start. Applicants still finishing a master's co-sign a thesis summary with a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: It is not necessary; in general, the supervisor will be assigned by the Academic Board within four months

funding.value: Scholarship and no-scholarship places are filled by one competition. The sheet lists 9 positions.
funding.quote: Successful candidates, with or without a scholarship, must enrol by July 23rd 2026

entry_route.value: A master's degree is required, plus passing the admission examination announced for each cycle.
entry_route.quote: You can access the PhD programme, which lasts 3 or 4 years, only after obtaining a master's degree and passing an admission examination, which is announced annually.

gre_general.value: The sheet says GRE scores are welcome 'if available' (GRE General and GRE Mathematics). No minimum is stated.
gre_general.quote: At most 2 reference letters. GRE, GRE ... Mathematics, if available

notes: TOEFL, IELTS and similar certificates are also 'if available' in the sheet, with no minimum. Admission exam in English; English proficiency assessed at the oral exam.
